BSC26-036.name: Fake Godzilla
BSC26-036.effect:
This Spirit/Spirit card is also treated as [Mecha Godzilla].

[LV1][LV2] (When Depleted/Destroyed by the Opponent)
You can reveal three cards from your decktop. Add a "MechaGodzilla"/"Type-3 Kiryu"-named Spirit card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

BSC26-040.name: MOGUERA II-SRF
BSC26-040.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] Red/Green/Blue
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Green/Blue Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Blocks)
This Spirit gains +5000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
This Spirit can block while exhausted.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1315.name: The Anti-G Weapon Super MechaGodzilla
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A1315.effect:
[Burst: After your Spirit is depleted/destroyed by the Opponent]
Reveal three cards from your decktop. Summon any number of "MechaGodzilla"/"Type-3 Kiryu"-named Spirit cards among them, without paying the costs. Discard any remaining cards. After this effect resolves, summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
Your White Spirits with Soul Core on them can't be blocked by opposing Spirits.

BSC26-011.name: Destoroyah (Flying Form)
BSC26-011.effect:
When your "Destoroyah"-named Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, you can summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Destroyed)
You can summon a Cost 8 or more "Destoroyah"-named Spirit card from your Hand.

BSC26-025.name: Gaira
BSC26-025.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
You can exhaust a Spirit you or the opponent controls. When a Cost 6 or more Spirit was exhausted via this effect, this Spirit refreshes.

BSC26-033.name: Garu Garu
BSC26-033.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Destroyed)
You can reveal five cards from your decktop. You can summon a "Garu Garu"-named Spirit card among them, without paying the cost. Discard any unsummoned and remaining cards.

[LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Red.

BSC26-039.name: Garu Garu II
BSC26-039.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Return an opposing Cost 5 or less Spirit to the Hand. By sending the [Soul Core] (Soul Core) from this Spirit to your Trash, also, refresh this Spirit.

[LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Red.

BSC26-003.name: Godzilla［1954］
BSC26-003.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Green.

BSC26-004.name: Godzilla［1965］
BSC26-004.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
This Spirit's color and symbol are also treated as Green.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Draw a card.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4561.name: Godzilla［1971］
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A4561.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return a Spirit card from your Trash to the Hand. Also, if [Soul Core] is on your Green Spirit, exhaust an opposing Spirit.

BSC26-015.name: Godzilla［1989］
BSC26-015.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
You can target and attack an opposing Spirit. When you target attacked the opposing Spirit with the highest BP via this effect, this Spirit gains +10000 BP.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by BP comparison, destroy an opposing Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6230.name: Laser Gravitational Beam
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A6230.effect:
[Flash]
Return an opposing Spirit to the Hand. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is used to pay the cost, also, refresh a "Ghidorah"-named Spirit you control.

BSC26-022.name: Lightspeed Mode Mothra
BSC26-022.effect:
Flash - [High Speed]
This Spirit card in Hand can be summoned by paying the cost with cores in the Reserve. In this case, cores to be put on this Spirit must also be from the Reserve.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Refresh a "Mothra"-named Spirit you control.

BSC26-021.name: Primitive Mothra
BSC26-021.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your other "Mothra"-named Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, by exhausting this Spirit, they remain on the Field, exhausted.

BSC26-026.name: Sanda
BSC26-026.effect: When your Green Spirit is destroyed by the opponent, you can summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost. Then, if the destroyed Spirit was [Gaira], it remains on the Field, refreshed.

BSC26-048.name: Scales & Prism Beam
BSC26-048.effect:
[Flash]
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. Then, if you control "Mothra"-named Spirit and "Battra"-named Spirit, one of each, return an opposing exhausted Spirit to their deckbottom.

BSC26-002.name: Shin-Godzilla (First Form)
BSC26-002.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Add a "Shin-Godzilla"-named Spirit card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
By destroying this Spirit, summon a [Shin-Godzilla (Second Form)] from your Hand, without paying the cost.

BSC26-X01.name: Shin-Godzilla (Fourth Form)
BSC26-X01.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 15000 BP.

[LV2][LV3] (Opposing Attack Step)
When an opposing Spirit attacks, destroy an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's.

[LV3]
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Brave/Nexus/Magic effects.

BSC26-005.name: Shin-Godzilla (Second Form)
BSC26-005.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Destroy an opposing Nexus.

[LV1][LV2] (Your Main Step)
By destroying this Spirit, summon a [Shin-Godzilla (Third Form)] from your Hand, without paying the cost.

BSC26-012.name: Shin-Godzilla (Third Form)
BSC26-012.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Main Step)
By destroying this Spirit, summon a [Shin-Godzilla (Fourth Form)] from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
By destroying an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit, refresh this Spirit.

BSC26-047.name: Shin-Godzilla Resistance Strategy
BSC26-047.effect:
[Flash]
Destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 5000 BP. When you or the opponent control any "Godzilla"-named Spirit, instead, destroy any number of opposing Spirits up to a total of 15000 BP.

BSC26-037.name: Super XII
BSC26-037.effect:
[LV1][LV2] Red/Purple
This Spirit is unaffected by opposing Red/Purple Spirit/Ultimate/Nexus/Magic effects.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can discard an opposing Burst. When you've done so, return an opposing Spirit to the Hand.

BSC26-041.name: The Anti-G Special Weapon Type-3 Kiryu (Berserk)
BSC26-041.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Either Attack Step)
This Spirit must attack/block if possible.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Return all opposing Spirits with a BP equal or inferior to this Spirit's to the Hand.

BSC26-042.name: The Anti-G Special Weapon Type-3 Kiryu (Modified)
BSC26-042.effect:
Flash - (Opposing Attack Step)
When you or the opponent controls any "Godzilla"-named Spirit, you can summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2] (When Blocks)
When only the opposing Spirit is destroyed by BP comparison, refresh this Spirit.

BSC26-X03.name: The BioKaiju Biollante
BSC26-X03.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Cores on both players' Spirits/Ultimates can't be removed.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. If the Spirit exhausted by this effect has two or less cores on it, refresh this Spirit.

BSC26-018.name: The CompleteLifeform Destoroyah
BSC26-018.effect:
When summoning this Spirit card, by returning up to seven "Destoroyah"-named Spirit cards from your Trash to the Hand, for each card returned, this card gets -1 cost.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
You can discard five cards from your decktop. For each Spirit card among them, destroy an opposing 10000 BP or less Spirit.

BSC26-019.name: The CyborgKaiju Gigan
BSC26-019.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your Red Spirit attacks, return an opposing Spirit with a BP equal or inferior to that Spirit's to the Hand.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your White Spirit attacks, draw a card.

[LV3]
This Spirit's symbol is also treated as White.

BSC26-X05.name: The CyborgKaiju Mecha-King Ghidorah
BSC26-X05.effect:
When your "Ghidorah"-named Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, you can summon this Spirit card from the Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
Return an opposing Spirit to the decktop. Then, destroy two opposing 10000 BP or less Spirits.

[LV2]
When your Red/White Spirit refreshes, you can activate this Spirit's (When Summoned) effect.

BSC26-034.name: The CyborgKaiju MechaGodzilla
BSC26-034.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Start of Opposing Attack Step)
You can target an opposing Spirit. That Spirit must attack at the start of the step if possible.

[LV2][LV3]
While [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is on this Spirit, all your "MechaGodzilla"/"Type-3 Kiryu"-named Spirits gain +5000 BP.

BSC26-016.name: The DemonKing Yamata-no-Orochi
BSC26-016.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Destroy eight opposing 6000 BP or less Spirits and eight opposing Nexuses.

[LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 8000 BP or more Spirit.

BSC26-031.name: The DestructionDemonicBeast Battra
BSC26-031.effect:
This Spirit/Spirit card is also treated as [Battra].

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing Nexus. Put cores from the Void to this Spirit equal to the level of the destroyed Nexus.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.

BSC26-027.name: The GiantMoth Mothra
BSC26-027.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When your "Mothra"/"Battra"-named Spirits are destroyed by the opponent, you can summon a Green Spirit card with a cost higher than the destroyed Spirit's from your Hand, without paying the cost.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit.

BSC26-006.name: The God of Destruction Space Godzilla
BSC26-006.effect:
This card/Spirit is also treated as being exactly-named "Space Godzilla".

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
You can reveal four cards from your decktop. Add a Nexus card among them to the Hand. Discard any remaining cards.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
For each Nexus you control, destroy an opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit.

BSC26-023.name: The GuardianDeityBeast Mothra
BSC26-023.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Put a core from the Void to this Spirit. If [Soul Core] (Soul Core) is on this Spirit, also, this Spirit gains +3000 BP.

BSC26-030.name: The GuardianDeityBeast Rainbow Mothra
BSC26-030.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Exhaust an opposing Spirit. Or, exhaust three opposing Cost 4 or less Spirits.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Mothra"-named Spirit attacks, return an opposing exhausted Spirit to the Hand.

BSC26-029.name: The InsectKaiju Megalon
BSC26-029.effect:
[Burst: After the opposing Hand increases via an opposing effect]
Summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
For each two cards in the opposing Hand, exhaust an opposing Spirit.

[LV2] (When Attacks)
When this Spirit's attack reduces the opposing Life, send an opposing Life to their Reserve.

BSC26-043.name: The Invasion of Shin-Godzilla
BSC26-043.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Your Draw Step)
Increase the number of cards you draw by +1. After drawing, discard a card from your Hand.

[LV2] (Your Attack Step)
When your "Shin-Godzilla"-named Spirit attacks, by returning two "Shin-Godzilla"-named Spirit cards from your Trash to the deckbottom in any order, refresh that Spirit.

BSC26-X02.name: The KaijuKing Burning Godzilla
BSC26-X02.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
Neither player can remove cores from this Spirit.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (Your End Step)
Put two cores from the Void to this Spirit. Then, if there are eight or more cores on this Spirit, destroy this Spirit, and destroy every opposing 20000 BP or less Spirit.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 12000 BP or less Spirit.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11060.name: The KaijuKing Emerges
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A11060.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When the opponent draws, refresh a "Godzilla"-named Spirit you control.

[LV2]
All your "Godzilla"-named Spirit can't be returned to Hand/Deck by opposing effects.

BSC26-010.name: The KaijuKing Godzilla［2000］
BSC26-010.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3]
When this Spirit is destroyed by opposing effects, it remains on the Field, exhausted.

[LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 6000 BP or less Spirit, and draw a card.

BSC26-035.name: The Maser Tank 92
BSC26-035.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks)
Return an opposing Spirit with a cost equal or inferior to this Spirit's to the Hand.

BSC26-045.name: The Rose Blooming in the Lake
BSC26-045.effect:
[LV1][LV2]
When your Green Cost 4 or more Spirit is summoned, put a core from the Void to this Nexus.

[LV2] Flash - (Either Attack Step)
By sending five cores from this Nexus to your Trash, summon a "Biollante"-named Spirit card from your Hand, without paying the cost.

BSC26-017.name: The SmogKaiju Hedorah
BSC26-017.effect:
When your Red/Purple Spirit is summoned, you can summon this Spirit card from the Trash.

[LV1][LV2] (When Attacks/Blocks)
Destroy an opposing Spirit which battled this Spirit during battle resolution at the end of the battle.

BSC26-014.name: The SpaceSuperDemonicBeast Desghidorah
BSC26-014.effect:
[Burst: After your Life is reduced]
Summon this Spirit card without paying the cost.

[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Summoned)
Either destroy every opposing 5000 BP or less Spirit, or destroy every opposing 15000 BP or less Green Spirits.

[LV2][LV3] (Your Attack Step)
All your "Ghidorah"-named Spirits gain an extra Red symbol.

BSC26-009.name: The SpaceSuperKaiju King Ghidorah
BSC26-009.effect:
[LV1][LV2][LV3] (When Attacks)
Destroy an opposing 4000 BP or less Spirit. If [Soul Core](Soul Core) is on this Spirit, also, draw a card.

BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13695.name: The Wreckage of Mecha-King Ghidorah's Head
BATTLE-SPIRITS-A13695.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (Opposing Attack Step)
All your White Spirits gain +3000 BP.

[LV2] (Your End Step)
Refresh all "MechaGodzilla"/"Type-3 Kiryu"/"Mecha-King Ghidorah"-named Spirits you control.

BSC26-028.name: Underwater Mode Mothra
BSC26-028.effect:
[LV1][LV2] (When Summoned)
For each "Mothra"-named Spirit you control, exhaust an opposing Spirit.
